blocks.raw: ### API Guides and Help for developers
blocks.text: API Guides and Help for developers

blocks.raw: The Modulr API platform lets developers securely manage and automate the flow of money for their company by creating eMoney accounts and making payments.
blocks.text: The Modulr API platform lets developers securely manage and automate the flow of money for their company by creating eMoney accounts and making payments.

blocks.raw: The API is based on REST, and uses standard REST features such as resource-based endpoints, HTTP verbs, standard responses and authentication.
blocks.text: The API is based on REST, and uses standard REST features such as resource-based endpoints, HTTP verbs, standard responses and authentication.

blocks.raw: **Some example use cases for the Modulr API:**
blocks.text: Some example use cases for the Modulr API:

blocks.raw:
* Automating payments
* Automating cards
* Creating discrete accounts to streamline incoming payments, receiving notifications of incoming funds via a webhook notification
* Managing funds on behalf of 3rd parties
blocks.text: Automating paymentsAutomating cardsCreating discrete accounts to streamline incoming payments, receiving notifications of incoming funds via a webhook notificationManaging funds on behalf of 3rd parties

blocks.raw: ### Modulr Portal Guides and Help
blocks.text: Modulr Portal Guides and Help

blocks.raw: The Modulr Portal is a great tool to use during development (it's connected to your Sandbox API account) and can be used to give your end-users secure access to their Modulr eMoney accounts and to perform actions that your integration doesn't support (depending on your integration and partnership model). They can make and receive payments, manage approvals and view payment statuses in real time. They can also set up notifications and manage other users as well as take advantage of many other features.
blocks.text: The Modulr Portal is a great tool to use during development (it's connected to your Sandbox API account) and can be used to give your end-users secure access to their Modulr eMoney accounts and to perform actions that your integration doesn't support (depending on your integration and partnership model). They can make and receive payments, manage approvals and view payment statuses in real time. They can also set up notifications and manage other users as well as take advantage of many other features.

blocks.raw: When using the Portal in Sandbox mode, there are restrictions you can learn about here: [Sandbox Account Restrictions](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/gaining-use-of-the-api)
